Title: Customer registration
I want: to create an account with my email and password
So that: I can place orders and have my details remembered

Title: Customer login
I want: to sign in with my email and password
So that: I can access my cart orders and saved address

Title: Stay signed in across sessions
I want: to remain signed in when I close and reopen the browser
So that: I do not have to log in every time

Title: Protected routes and authorisation
I want: to block unauthenticated users from checkout and order pages
So that: orders are always attributable to a real account

Title: Browse restaurants
I want: to see a list of available restaurants with key details
So that: I can decide where to order from

Title: Search restaurants by name
I want: to search restaurants by name
So that: I can find a place without scrolling

Title: Filter restaurants by cuisine
I want: to filter restaurants by cuisine type
So that: I can narrow the list to the kind of food I feel like

Title: See delivery fee and ETA before opening a menu
I want: to see the delivery fee and estimated time on the restaurant card
So that: I am not surprised by fees at checkout

Title: View a restaurant's menu
I want: to view a restaurant's full menu with prices and descriptions
So that: I can choose what to order

Title: Menu grouped by category
I want: menu items grouped into categories like Starters Mains and Desserts
So that: I can navigate a long menu quickly

Title: Veg / non-veg indicator
I want: a clear veg/non-veg marker on every dish
So that: I can order confidently without reading each description

Title: Add items to cart
I want: to add menu items to my cart
So that: I can order several dishes together

Title: Change quantity and remove items
I want: to increase decrease or remove items in my cart
So that: I can correct my order before paying

Title: Cart persists across page reloads
I want: my cart to survive a page refresh or accidental tab close
So that: I do not lose my selections

Title: Single-restaurant cart guard
I want: to reset the cart when a customer adds an item from a different restaurant
So that: impossible multi-restaurant orders can never be created

Title: Transparent bill summary
I want: to see item total delivery fee and grand total clearly itemised
So that: I know exactly what I am paying before I commit

Title: Enter delivery address and choose payment method
I want: to confirm my delivery address and pick how I will pay
So that: my food reaches the right place by my preferred method

Title: Place an order
I want: to place my order with one click
So that: the restaurant starts preparing my food

Title: Server-side price calculation
I want: all order totals recomputed on the server from database prices
So that: a malicious client cannot pay less than the real price

Title: Live order tracking timeline
I want: to watch my order move through clear stages in real time
So that: I know when to expect my food

Title: Cancel an order
I want: to cancel my order if I change my mind early
So that: I am not charged for food I no longer want

Title: View order history
I want: to see all my past orders
So that: I can check what I spent and reorder favourites

Title: Advance order status through the lifecycle
I want: to move an order through its preparation stages
So that: the customer always sees an accurate status

Title: Mark items and restaurants unavailable
I want: to mark a dish sold out or my restaurant closed
So that: I never receive orders I cannot fulfil

Title: One-command containerised local setup
I want: to start the entire application with a single command
So that: I can contribute on day one without fighting environment setup
